mapper.select: SELECT vd.*, u.university_name as university_name, u.level_tags as university_level, u.province as university_province, m.major_name as major_name, m.category as major_category, ap.min_score, ap.min_rank, ap.avg_score FROM user_volunteer_detail vd LEFT JOIN gaokao_university u ON vd.university_id = u.id LEFT JOIN gaokao_major m ON vd.major_id = m.id LEFT JOIN gaokao_admission_plan ap ON ap.major_id = m.id AND ap.university_id = u.id WHERE vd.volunteer_plan_id = #{volunteerId} ORDER BY vd.priority_no

SELECT vd.*, msm.matching_score, msm.importance_level, msm.description as matching_description FROM user_volunteer_detail vd LEFT JOIN hs_major_subject_match msm ON msm.major_code = ( SELECT major_code FROM gaokao_major WHERE id = vd.major_id ) WHERE vd.id = #{volunteerDetailId}
